SELECT i_item_id, 
       AVG(ss_quantity) AS agg1, 
       AVG(ss_list_price) AS agg2, 
       AVG(ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, 
       AVG(ss_sales_price) AS agg4 
FROM store_sales 
JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk 
      FROM customer_demographics 
      WHERE cd_gender = 'F' 
        AND cd_marital_status = 'W' 
        AND cd_education_status = 'College') AS filtered_cdemo 
  ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = filtered_cdemo.cd_demo_sk 
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk 
      FROM date_dim 
      WHERE d_year = 2001) AS filtered_date 
  ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk 
JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
JOIN (SELECT p_promo_sk 
      FROM promotion 
      WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N') AS filtered_promo 
  ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = filtered_promo.p_promo_sk 
GROUP BY i_item_id 
ORDER BY i_item_id 
LIMIT 100
